newsitem.title: USA: Sony to introduce DVD format in April.
newsitem.headline: Sony to introduce DVD format in April.

text.p: Sony Corp said it plans in April to introduce hardware and software with the DVD optical disk format.
The company will introduce a "reference-standard" CD/DVD video player, DVD-ROM drives and high-quality movie and music entertainment programs targeted at video- and audiophiles.
Sony also said that it agreed with Viacom Inc's Blockbuster to expand their existing VHS promotion and demonstration programs to include DVD.

Blockbuster will feature in-store demonstration kiosks with Sony DVD players at certain locations, with purchasers of Sony's new DVD player getting special coupons awarding them free DVD rentals at Blockbuster.
